intro: BBC Sport has reported that Hull City have completed the signings of English forward Joe Gelhardt from Leeds and French midfielder Lucas Gourna-Douath from Red Bull Salzburg. Both moves were announced for undisclosed fees. The arrivals add attacking and midfield options to Hull’s squad and represent notable incoming business for the club.
